originalBody:
okay this is the sweetest thing — taylor is just a fan too 🤍

on the tonight show, jimmy fallon asked her the last song she'd had on repeat, and she lit all the way up about someone else's: 'oh, tate mcrae has a great new song called "tit for tat," you gotta listen to it.' then — 'full volume, over and over again on repeat. it's just so good.'

and it wasn't a one-off. on siriusxm she named tate mcrae, sabrina carpenter and sombr as the three artists she's constantly streaming at home right now.

tate's been so open about what it meant to her — she's called it one of the coolest moments ever, the kind you facetime all your friends about.

there's something so lovely about the biggest pop star in the world still getting giddy over a song the way the rest of us do. tag the friend you'd text 'you HAVE to hear this' to 🤍
